g.text: The wider candidate changes the physical array to a 300 × 200 mm bounding box. It fits within the assumed 340 × 232 mm outline, but mechanical feasibility is unverified.
All other candidates use a 200 mm maximum-diameter spiral. More microphones redistribute the spiral; geometry and count change together.
